title: Vintage Christian Dior Italian Majolica Set – Hand-Painted Covered Bowl & Wall Plate – Made in Italy
description:
Beautiful vintage Christian Dior majolica ceramic set composed of a hand-painted covered bowl with elegant scroll handles and a matching decorative wall plate. Both pieces feature rich Renaissance-inspired floral motifs in cobalt blue, olive green, terracotta and golden tones, characteristic of traditional Italian majolica craftsmanship.
Signed “Christian Dior – Made in Italy” with the iconic bee mark underneath, these pieces are associated with vintage Dior Maison decorative tableware and Italian faience production.
The wall plate comes with its display hanger attached and is ready to display. The covered bowl is equally decorative and refined, making this ensemble ideal for collectors of luxury vintage tableware, Italian ceramics or sophisticated Mediterranean interiors.
Very good vintage condition overall with vibrant colors and glossy finish. One small chip is present underneath on the foot rim of the covered bowl (see photos), not visible during display. No visible cracks.
A rare and highly decorative vintage ensemble, perfect for display in a dining room, kitchen, cabinet or curated interior space.
Sold as a set of 2 pieces.
Made in Italy – hand painted.
